title: Offer optional dynamic retrieval behind a configurable Retriever
description:
## Purpose

Offer dynamic per-item example retrieval as a **separate, optional feature, off by default**, with interchangeable retrievers behind one interface.

## Scope

- `Retriever` / `RetrievalIndex` / `VectorStore` protocols and a `retrieval:` config independent of the few-shot optimizer toggle.
- Lexical v2 (stop words on by default, negations kept; v1 frozen).
- In-memory embedding retriever (exact cosine), the simplest semantic option.
- S3 Vectors and DynamoDB vector search: **design-only stubs** behind the same `VectorStore` interface; not built in this phase.
- Owner phasing: Phase 3, after the fixed bundle. Native, provider-neutral, core stays dependency-free (numpy and embedding providers only as optional extras). No DSPy.

## Definition of done

Child stories closed with specs first and green; the evaluations retrieval proxy can plug each retriever in; with default config no retrieval request is ever made.

## Design

[DECISION_FLYWHEEL_DESIGN.md](https://github.com/AnthusAI/Decision-Flywheel-Evaluations/blob/main/studies/DECISION_FLYWHEEL_DESIGN.md) §4, Appendix B.

## Companion-project coordination

- [Decision-Flywheel-Evaluations](https://github.com/AnthusAI/Decision-Flywheel-Evaluations/tree/main/project/issues): `decision-flywheel-evaluations-f06dcf08-6182-41ce-a9f5-31b37d08bf51`.

These are cross-repository references; local Kanbus blocked-by relationships encode prerequisites within this repository.

comments.text:
Implemented on branch `phase3-retrieval` (worktree Decision-Flywheel-phase3), commits 0b15981 and fed787d; not merged or pushed. Offline only: specs use fake embedders, no network. `make test` equivalent: 289 passed (226 existing + 63 new).

Status: all four children implemented and specced; awaiting owner review and merge. Defaults unchanged: `RetrievalConfig().enabled is False` and `build_retrieval_policy` returns `None`, so no index is built and no embedding is requested. Modules: `retrieval.py` (protocols, `PerLabelRetrieval`, `neighbour_label_purity`), `lexical_retrieval.py`, `embedding_retrieval.py`, `vector_stores.py`, `retrieval_config.py`.

Not done here: artifact rehydration of retrieval policies (artifacts.py only accepts version-1 policies), and no evaluations-harness wiring.
